system.notes:
Four-armed, moss-coated tree being, blackened and blighted. Hates humans and halflings, rules forest lands.

AC 14, HP 58, ATK 3 claw +6 (1d10 + deadwood) or mold blast, MV near, S +5, D +4, C +4, I +4, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 12

Deadwood. On a natural attack roll of 20, WIS 15+ or cursed, one limb transformed into wood, d4: 1. right arm, 2. left arm, 3. right leg, 4. left leg.

Mold Blast. Spray yellow mold, near-sized cube extending from mosslord, CON 15+ or 1 CON damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check once per round; ends on success.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by magical sources. Immune to fire.
